name: @octoglyphs/claude-code-plugin
description: Privacy-first OctoGlyphs companion plugin for Claude Code.

scripts.copy:game: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../../../game/dist/. public/ && rm -rf public/assets/raw/Halloween\ assets public/assets/raw/Enemies public/assets/raw/gems public/assets/raw/Old\ cycles public/assets/raw/UI/Play public/assets/raw/UI/Settings public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/deep2.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/deep3.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/deep4.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/shallow2.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/shallow3.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/shallow4.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/mid*.png public/assets/raw/Backgrounds/newbg*.png
scripts.build:game: npm --prefix ../../../game install && npm --prefix ../../../game run build -- --logLevel warn
scripts.build: npm run build:game && npm run copy:game
